lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: Excuse me, is this seat taken?

lines.speaker: Nora
lines.text: No, it's free.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: Do you mind if I sit here?

lines.speaker: Nora
lines.text: Not at all. Go ahead. I'll move my bag.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: Thank you. Could I put my coat above us?

lines.speaker: Nora
lines.text: Sure. There's plenty of space.

lines.speaker: Nora
lines.text: Is the aisle seat comfortable enough? This part of the train is a little narrow.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: It's fine, thanks. I'll keep my small bag under the seat so it doesn't block the aisle.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: It's busier than usual today.

lines.speaker: Nora
lines.text: It is. I think a conference is starting downtown.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: That explains all the suitcases.

lines.speaker: Nora
lines.text: I take this train twice a week, and I can usually find an empty row.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: The last time I took it was last month. The later morning service is normally quieter.

lines.speaker: Nora
lines.text: I guess everyone had the same idea today.

lines.speaker: Nora
lines.text: Are you getting off at Central Station too?

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: Yes. I'm meeting a friend near the west entrance. How about you?

lines.speaker: Nora
lines.text: I'm changing there for the airport line.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: Then you have one more train after this.

lines.speaker: Nora
lines.text: Unfortunately, yes.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: Well, I'll let you get back to your podcast.

lines.speaker: Nora
lines.text: And I'll let you get back to your book. It was nice talking with you.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: You too. Have a good trip.

lines.speaker: Nora
lines.text: Thanks. You too.
